title: Fix KosDB Installation to Use System LevelDB
instructions: Update the KosDB installation process so it uses the system leveldb (with RTTI) instead of building the leveldb_for_KosDB fork, which avoids the plyvel undefined symbol error. Also ensure Cython is available for the plyvel build.

1785668429.0451014.instruction: Modify install.sh to install system leveldb via apt (or check it exists), skip the leveldb_for_KosDB fork build, and build plyvel_for_KosDB against the system leveldb. Add Cython installation before building plyvel.

1785668429.046124.instruction: Add cython as a build dependency in requirements.txt (or a separate build requirement note) since plyvel needs it to generate _plyvel.cpp from _plyvel.pyx.

1785668429.0462358.instruction: Add a note in the installation documentation explaining that system leveldb is used and the fork build is not required.

1785668429.0463371.instruction: Read back install.sh and requirements.txt to confirm changes are correct and consistent.
